g.text: HOT PREHEAT TRAIN E-106 TO E-111 & E-113
1. Hot train crude-side design pressure per P-102 shut-off (see line list); exchanger rating to be confirmed.
2. E-113 kettle MP steam generator: 3-element level control simplified to LIC-1110 at FEED.
3. TV-2017 controlled from TIC-2017 (HVGO pumparound return temperature) on CFU-200-PR-PID-014.
4. Line numbers: <NPS>-<fluid>-<area>-<seq>-<class>-<insulation> per CONVENTIONS; see line list CFU-000-PI-LL-001.
5. All vents / drains 3/4" min. with blind or cap; HPV/LPD to piping specification. Valve sizes = line size UNO.
6. Instrument tags per ISA-5.1; index CFU-000-IC-IDX-001. SIS functions per SRS (SIF tags shown in interlocks).
SHELL: BFW / MP steam / TUBE: Bottom pumparound
